The company also said it "does not intend" to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

articles.title: Nvidia board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang, chairman says
articles.summary: The Nvidia board "does not intend to reinstate" Jensen Huang as CEO, the newly appointed board chair, Harvey Jones, said on their quarterly earnings call. [outlet]' Allie Canal and Sahil Kapur discuss how Nvidia topped estimates despite Huang's ouster.

articles.title: Students at $90K-a-year college forced to fight off dorm intruder accused of grabbing woman by the throat
articles.summary: Diaunte Adams allegedly followed a Northwestern University student from a train into her dorm, bypassing two layers of security before students stepped in.

articles.title: Man accused of attacking Northwestern student followed others from train to dorms
articles.summary: A man who is accused of attempting to strangle a Northwestern University student in her dorm room got into the building after following two other students to the campus from the train, prosecutors said.

articles.title: Government investigators find AI platforms produce terror plot plans in undercover op
articles.summary: GAO investigators bypassed AI safeguards on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, obtaining feasible plans for terrorist attacks in under 12 hours of testing.

articles.title: AI platforms planned U.S. terror attack when asked to
articles.summary: The incoming chair of the Senate Homeland Security Committee is preparing hearings on AI after government watchdogs found the four most-used platforms all created proposals for a U.S. terrorist attack when prompted by investigators.

articles.title: Watch: Geyser of Rotting Garbage Erupts in Los Angeles County
articles.summary: A geyser of rotting garbage erupted in Los Angeles County Monday afternoon, prompting an emergency health order.

articles.title: Mountain of trash explodes in Los Angeles County: "Absolutely our worst nightmare"
articles.summary: What looked like a volcanic eruption in Los Angeles County was actually a high-pressure explosion from a mountain of trash. Carter Evans has the latest updates.

articles.title: Haiti: Thousands Peacefully Cheer for Nayib Bukele and El Salvador's Soldiers
articles.summary: Thousands of Haitians on Tuesday once again marched in support of El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele and the Salvadoran troops deployed in the country.

articles.title: Iran Fires on Kuwait After U.S. Self-Defense Strike on Iranian Island
articles.summary: U.S. forces struck a missile launch site on Iran’s Qeshm Island on Tuesday night in “self defense” after Iran attacked U.S. targets in Bahrain. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) responded by attacking U.S. ally Kuwait for the first time since September.

articles.title: U.S. launches strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island in Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: The strikes came after Iran launched attacks against U.S. radar systems in Bahrain three times in less than a week.
